item.title: HiTHIUM Recognized as the World’s First Lighthouse Factory for Energy Storage Batteries
item.description: CHONGQING, China, Jan. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — The World Economic Forum (WEF) recently announced the latest members of its Global Lighthouse Networks 2026, with HiTHIUM’s Chongqing manufacturing base successfully selected. The factory becomes the world’s first Lighthouse Factory for energy storage batteries, marking a major milestone for the global energy storage industry. The factory is also the world’s first mass-production facility dedicated to kAh long-duration energy storage (LDES) battery.
